impulse_concentration.description: share of total absolute movement carried by the top 1% / 5% / 10% of bars - if markets are noise most of the time with distinct impulse points, these must be hugely disproportionate. The verdict uses the concentration RATIO: top-5% share divided by 5% (uniform = 1.0)

crash_bounce.description: forward 10-day return after a <= -7% day (and <= -15% nuclear day) vs the unconditional baseline

time_at_price.description: after >= 5 bars of congestion at one price, how often does price RETURN to that level (within 0.5%) within 60 bars? - the daily-bar approximation of the last-orderbook-low idea

compression_impulse.description: after the tightest trailing 10-bar ranges (bottom 20% of their trailing history), is the next 20-bar move larger than baseline? - the horizontal-time-before-impulse claim

impulse_follow_through.description: after a >= 3% impulse bar, does the next 5-day move continue (trend) or revert (exhaustion)? - the impulse/correction alternation claim

untestable_on_dailies: the framework's 5/15-minute max-hold and fast-fail rules require intraday (orderbook / minute-bar) data; recorded honestly as out of scope for daily bars
